summary: Architectural specification and design documentation for the ClankerLog CLI tool.
responsibilities: Defines the ingestion API contract and validation rules for clank events.
Outlines CLI requirements, including privacy gates, project allow-listing, and command specifications.
Details configuration file schemas for both global (~/.config/clankerlog/config.json) and local (.clankerlog.json) settings.
Specifies core CLI commands including login, init, allow, ping, and doctor.
Provides guidance for implementing hook integrations for coding agents like Codex.
